correctness.rationale: The source and local equation give a unique cusp and tangent. Projective linear algebra reduces a stabilizer to (x,y)->(Ax+C,Dx+By+E); normalization sends t to at+b. The t^2 coefficient of (at+b)^(q+2) is b^q a^2 and has no mate on the left since q>=4; it forces b=0. Remaining coefficients impose D=E=0 and a^(q+1)=1. Conversely all these diagonal maps preserve the defining equation. Exact finite symbolic checks corroborate the polynomial pattern but are not the universal proof.

The order q+1 finite group gives a sharp rigidity phenomenon invisible from the A1-normalization and distinguishes intrinsic versus ambient projective symmetries.
